title: VTA Events — Registrations — Decide — payload
description: A client accepts or declines a pending registration, or removes one, for an event the VTA holds; the registrant's next read shows the decision. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

decision.description: `accept` or `decline` a `pending` registration; `remove` one that is `going`, `maybe`, `pending` or `waitlisted`.

note.description: Shown to the registrant on the registration.

Response.title: VTA Events — Registrations — Decide — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vta/events/registrations/decide/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vta/events/registrations/decide/0.1#response.
